title: Louella has already bought the house
summary: She had paid the down payment the night before; she also had fifteen thousand dollars hidden in the room.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So, long about twelve o'clock--noontime--she say, "You hongry?"
I say, "Y'eahhh, I could eat somethin'."
She say, "Well, we'll get up, and we'll go to the restaurant."
I say, "I don't feel like gettin' up, goin' to no restaurant."
I say, "It's a restaurant down at that other hotel where I used to live at. They got delivery, so why not call up down there and tell them to bring us some food?"
She say, "No, it's all right. I'll go get it." She say, "That restaurant not too hot anyway. I'll go get you the food."
So she went got up an' went took a shower. She got up out of the bed, sit on th' side o' the bed for awhile an' talked t' me. Then she got up again. So she went out an' got the food, brought it back.
Reel 4
In the meantime, now, still wonderin', I say, "When're we goin' a buy the furniture?" M'open my big mouth.
She said, "Well, we'll go this afternoon an' pick out some furniture." So we goin' back over t' the house.
In the meantime, she had went over and made a down payment on that. I didn't know nothin' about it.
I say, "Well, how we gonna move in there if we ain't made no down payment?"
She said, "That's all taken care of."
I say, "Yeahhh?" Say, "When did you do that?"
Say, "I done that last night. I went to the people's office an' got it all straight. The house is ours."
"Why, you gotta be kiddin'." I say, "People don't do no business that fast."
She says, "Yeah! The house belongs to us now. We now property owner."
So I jumped up, got my bottle. I had a bottle settin' on the dresser. Poured me a big drink, said, "Sho-o-o-o-o nuff! So I'm a property owner. Married. I own some property. All in two months."
Say, "I've been runnin' aroun' here for twenty-five or thirty years an' ...an' he ain't...he ain't ownin' nothin'. Jus' makin' a joke," I says.
"Well, we in business now."
I said, "Good! When we gonna move in?"
She says, "Well, be 'bout a two weeks or three till they got to paint the place n' everything."
"Paint it? It look all right t'me."
Reel 4
Said, "No. I want it painted all over the way I want it painted. And they got to take up them old rugs an' put down some new rugs on the floor an' ever'thing."
I say, "Well, that's goin' to cost a lot of money."
She says, "Don't worry about it. It's all in the dresser... in the dresser drawers."
I say, "Well, I musta missed one of 'em."
So she opened another dresser drawer. She had a box o Kleenex with money all up in all them Kleenex. She had fifteen thousand dollars in the room...in the hotel room. So, she showed that to me.
I said, "Wellllll!"
